products.title: Nexus Firefight - Nexus
products.description:
NEXUS FIREFIGHT - A teardrop-shaped carbon power racket. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is a racket with which your game can shine due to its great power. With a great ball feel, this racket is perfect for all types of intermediate level players, being able to adapt to the conditions of the match at all times.

PLAYER TYPE 

Racquet specially designed for players looking to handle the blow without losing power in each of their blows. Intermediate level.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE 

This racket is characterized by its 3K carbon that provides durability and resistance. Its teardrop/diamond shape helps you have extra power with a more controlled game in the defensive phases of the game. 

Its smooth gloss finish makes its color stand out. Aesthetically it has a modern and striking design. Features a combination of glossy black with neon yellow and white details

PLAY STYLE

The NEXUS FIREFIGHT is designed for a balanced playstyle, albeit with a bias towards power.

products.title: Enebe Spitfire Black 12k 2025 - Enebe
products.description:
ENEBE SPITFIRE BLACK 12K 2025 - We have the new Spitfire 12K from the Enebe brand for the 2025 season, in the Black version. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ENEBE SPITFIRE BLACK 12K 2025 that we have on offer is an improved version of the Enebe Spitifire 2024, with a more serious and elegant color design. As always, high-end Enebe rackets made with the best materials and thus offer a product for the most demanding users.

The format we find is oversize teardrop. The most complete for both attack and defense.

PLAYER TYPE

The SPITFIRE BLACK 12K 2025 is recommended for medium-high level players.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

We find a racket made with a carbon frame, which generates greater stability and durability in its useful life. The planes are reinforced with 12k Carbon, causing medium stiffness in the ball feel and facilitating ball exit.

Inside we find a Black HR3 EVA Rubber that generates a pleasant touch and greater manageability in impacts. The oversized teardrop format allows for a larger sweet spot, which results in better control of the ball.

As for the design, we can see a smooth matte finish, highly requested by users last season.

PLAY STYLE

The ENEBE SPITFIRE BLACK 12k 2025 racket is focused on players looking for a complete racket, with careful aesthetics and a composition and manufacturing applied towards a versatile, durable and easy-to-use product. A medium-high level padel player who knows what his strengths are in attack and defense.

products.title: Softee Egon - Softee
products.description:
SOFTEE EGON - Racquet for players looking for control. Initiation level for your start on the right foot in this sport. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The SOFTEE EGON is a round format padel racket ideal for starting out. Its beautiful design and, above all, its low price, make it one of the best Softee rackets to become your first racket.

PLAYER TYPE

It is the ideal alternative to start playing paddle tennis. Its round format and low weight offer us all the facilities to pass the ball from the first contact.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

In terms of technical performance, we are looking at a round format racket, with low balance (necessary to have better control) and therefore its handling will be very good at all times.

Made of fiberglass, both in frame and in planes and with a soft S3 eva rubber, with a very comfortable soft touch.

PLAY STYLE

In the defense zone, the SOFTEE EGON is the best alternative in Softee rackets, especially if you are starting to play. It will help you move comfortably from the bottom.

products.title: Wilson Blade V4 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.
